reviewed_by: Codex focused review for chat side tool fullscreen and restore
reason: The Code 1 side pane gains a fullscreen control that preserves its mounted editor, active tab, and saved split width. Two collected component cases cover draft continuity, Escape, focus, background inertness, and close. Eight collected interface cases cover the linked-file journey and responsive fullscreen geometry in desktop Chromium and emulated mobile Chromium and WebKit, including landscape resizing. Three collected real-Core cases cover the same visible Code pane on a production non-loopback LAN origin with a durable file and reload.
exclusions: No Python or native behavior changed. Unrelated UI journeys and full suites are excluded. Mock browser cases use a development server; real-Core cases use disposable Core instances and the production UI bundle on a LAN origin. Physical devices are not available in this environment.
